region.title: Region
region.description: Required region code for your tenant's regional gateway: us, eu, ca, au, uk, uae or in. Obtain it from your tenant administrator. There is no default; URLs are not accepted.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: Required non-blank API client ID from your tenant's API credentials. There is no default.

clientSecret.title: Client secret reference
clientSecret.description: Reference the environment variable or absolute private file containing your API client secret, never the secret itself. If omitted, reads CHECKPOINT_AXI_CLIENT_SECRET; a missing or blank secret prevents authentication.

saas.title: SaaS application name
saas.description: One non-blank SaaS application name for the tenant, not a gateway, host or authentication URL; slash (/) is not allowed. Obtain the exact API application name from your tenant administrator or Check Point support. If omitted, defaults to office365_emails, selecting Microsoft 365 email; supply the appropriate name for another application. A profile takes one value, while --saas on event list accepts a comma-separated list.

scope.title: Download scope
scope.description: Download scope value supplied by your tenant administrator or Check Point support for the intended download. Use printable ASCII with no spaces (characters ! through ~); comma-separated values are sent verbatim. There is no default: omitted means unset, so email download fails because it requires the profile scope as its scopes header. Attachment download uses this only as the default scope query; --scope overrides it, and neither supplied means no scope query. Tenant scope authorization and the relationship between these selectors remain unverified; do not guess a value.

downloads.title: Download permission
downloads.description: Separate file-profile download opt-in. If omitted, downloads are disabled. Environment profiles cannot enable downloads.

allow.title: Allow downloads
allow.description: Set true to permit download commands; each command still requires a new private output file.

writes.title: Write permissions
writes.description: File-profile write opt-in and exact operation allow-list. If omitted, writes are disabled with no allowed operations. Forced read-only always wins.

allowWrites.title: Allow writes
allowWrites.description: Set true to permit listed operations, subject to preview, exact confirmation and durable redacted intent.

operations.title: Allowed write operations
operations.description: Exact operation names to allow, such as email.quarantine. An empty list permits no writes.

env.title: Secret environment variable
env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the secret, such as CHECKPOINT_AXI_CLIENT_SECRET. Use letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore.

file.title: Secret file path
file.description: Absolute path to a private UTF-8 file holding the secret. Symlinks and insecure permissions are rejected; a leading BOM and trailing whitespace are removed from its content.
